architecture.imageAlt: KubeDB Platform Architecture — layered stack from infrastructure through Kubernetes distributions, services, KubeDB Operator components, and KubeDB Platform features

layers.title: KubeDB Platform
layers.description: Web Console, Envoy Gateway, Hub/Spoke Model, and Policy Engine for complete DBaaS management

layers.title: KubeDB Operator
layers.description: Automated provisioning, operations, autoscaling, backup/restore, and database migration

layers.title: Kubernetes Services
layers.description: ArgoCD, Open Cluster Management, Cert Manager, Prometheus, and Grafana integration

layers.title: Kubernetes Platform
layers.description: Support for OpenShift, Rancher, EKS, GKE, AKS, and any CNCF-certified Kubernetes

layers.title: Infrastructure
layers.description: Deploy on-premises, in the cloud, or at the edge with complete flexibility

infoBox.title: White-Labeled Self-Service UI + REST APIs
infoBox.description: Beautiful, fully branded self-service portal with complete REST APIs for native integration into your cloud console. No requirement to expose KubeDB Platform UI directly — integrate seamlessly into your existing customer experience.

features.title: Provisioning & Lifecycle
features.description: Instant self-service launch via web portal, CLI, API, kubectl. Fully automated lifecycle: provisioning, upgrades, scaling, failover, repair, halt/resume.

features.title: High Availability & Resilience
features.description: Multi-AZ/multi-zone clustering with automatic failover and data replication. Continuous health checks with protection against accidental deletion.

features.title: Scaling & Storage
features.description: Horizontal and vertical scaling with zero downtime. Dynamic volume expansion with full history tracking including initial size, expansions, and timestamps.

features.title: Backup & Disaster Recovery
features.description: Policy-driven scheduled & on-demand backups to S3-compatible storage. Incremental, deduplicated, encrypted backups with snapshot lifecycle management.

features.title: Monitoring & Observability
features.description: OpenTelemetry collectors for end-user monitoring. Metrics in Thanos, logs & tracing in ClickHouse. Tenant-isolated Grafana and Perses dashboards.

features.title: Security & Compliance
features.description: Automated TLS/SSL via cert-manager. Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). RBAC, Pod Security Policies, Network Policies, Vault integration.

billing.title: Real-Time Metering API
billing.description: Access all required data with UTC timestamps

billing.title: Database Level Metrics
billing.description: Pod flavor (CPU/Memory), pod age, pod count (including autoscaling)

billing.title: Storage Tracking
billing.description: Volume name, initial size, expansion history (size + timestamp), creation/deletion timestamps

billing.title: Usage Calculation
billing.description: Sustained GiB RAM (730 hours/month) for accurate billing

billing.title: Seamless Integration
billing.description: RESTful and gRPC APIs for your billing platform

accessHybrid.title: Seamless Hybrid Access
accessHybrid.description: Your customers can connect from containerized microservices, serverless functions, traditional monoliths on VMs, or external SaaS applications — all using standard database protocols. No special clients or SDKs required.
